mapper.select: SELECT count(*) as pv, count(DISTINCT open_id) as uv, '' as time, 'app' as name FROM wx_click_log

SELECT hours.hour_of_day as time, IFNULL(wcl.count,0) as count FROM ( SELECT 0 AS hour_of_day UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 ) AS hours LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(*) as count, count(DISTINCT open_id) as count, HOUR(create_time) as time FROM wx_click_log WHERE create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{time}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{time}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY time ) AS wcl ON hours.hour_of_day = wcl.time ORDER BY hours.hour_of_day

SELECT months.day_of_month as time, IFNULL(wcl.count,0) as count FROM ( SELECT 1 AS day_of_month UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 UNION SELECT 30 UNION SELECT 31 ) AS months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(*) as count, count(DISTINCT open_id) as count, DAY(create_time) as time FROM wx_click_log WHERE create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{time}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{time}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY time ) AS wcl ON months.day_of_month = wcl.time ORDER BY months.day_of_month

SELECT years.year_of_month as time, IFNULL(wcl.count,0) as count FROM ( SELECT 1 AS year_of_month UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) AS years LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(*) as count, count(DISTINCT open_id) as count, MONTH(create_time) as time FROM wx_click_log WHERE create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{time}, '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{time}, '-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY time ) AS wcl ON years.year_of_month = wcl.time ORDER BY years.year_of_month
